El clon de un ítem arrastrado, para overlays personalizados que colocan ellos mismos varios ítems — y las props que reciben los componentes de overlay.
Las funciones que cambian adónde va el ítem arrastrado, y las que eligen el destino que tiene debajo.
Las opciones y los hooks de las animaciones — la ordenación, el drop y los cambios que no vienen de un arrastre.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { DnDProvider } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import MediaList from './MediaList.vue';

const media = (kind: 'photo' | 'video', n: number, hue: number) => ({ id: `${kind[0]}${n}`, kind, hue });
const library = ref([
  media('photo', 1, 200),
  media('photo', 2, 30),
  media('video', 1, 280),
  media('photo', 3, 140),
  media('photo', 4, 340),
  media('video', 2, 90),
  media('photo', 5, 250),
  media('photo', 6, 10),
]);
const album = ref([media('photo', 7, 170)]);
</script>

<template>
  <DnDProvider>
    <div class="demo">
      <MediaList id="library" v-model="library" title="Library" :columns="4" />
      <!-- Takes photos only: over it with a video, `accepted` is false. -->
      <MediaList id="album" v-model="album" title="Album · photos" :columns="3" photos-only />
    </div>
  </DnDProvider>
</template>

<style scoped>
.demo {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: center;
  align-content: flex-start;
  gap: 14px;
  /* Room above the lists for the overlay's caption, and below for the album to grow into:
     the lists never move under the pointer. */
  min-height: 300px;
  padding-top: 24px;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import MediaTile from './MediaTile.vue';
import StripOverlay from './StripOverlay.vue';

type Media = { id: string; kind: 'photo' | 'video'; hue: number };
const props = defineProps<{ id: string; title: string; columns: number; photosOnly?: boolean }>();
const media = defineModel<Media[]>({ required: true });

const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
const { items, isOver } = makeSortableList(list, {
  id: props.id,
  items: media,
  strategy: 'grid',
  // Every drag that starts here shows this component in the overlay box.
  overlay: StripOverlay,
  group: { name: 'media', put: ({ types }) => !props.photosOnly || types.every((type) => type === 'photo') },
  // Hold Alt while moving to the other list: a copy (`mode: 'copy'`).
  clone: (item) => ({ ...item, id: `${item.id}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}` }),
});
</script>

<template>
  <section class="shelf" :class="{ over: isOver }">
    <h3>{{ title }}</h3>
    <ul ref="list" :style="{ gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${columns}, 56px)` }">
      <MediaTile v-for="item in items" :key="item.id" :item="item" />
    </ul>
  </section>
</template>

<style scoped>
.shelf {

  border-radius: 12px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 4%, Canvas);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent);
  transition: box-shadow 0.15s;
}

}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableItem } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

const props = defineProps<{ item: { id: string; kind: 'photo' | 'video'; hue: number } }>();
const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
// `type` is what the album's `group.put` reads; click to select, then drag several.
const { selected } = makeSortableItem(el, { item: () => props.item, type: () => props.item.kind });
</script>

<template>
  <li
    ref="el"
    class="tile"
    :class="{ picked: selected }"
    :style="{ '--hue': item.hue }"
    :aria-label="`${item.kind} ${item.id}`"
    @click="selected = !selected"
  >
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
      <path v-if="item.kind === 'video'" d="M9 7.5v9l7.5-4.5z" />
      <path v-else d="m4 18 5-6 3.5 4 2.5-3 5 5zM16 9.5a1.5 1.5 0 1 0 0-.01z" />
    </svg>
    <span class="name">{{ item.id }}</span>
  </li>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { DragPreview, type Active, type DnDStatus, type DragItem, type DragMode, type Over } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

// The overlay props, written out (`OverlayProps` is the same type).
const props = defineProps<{
  active: Active;
  items: DragItem[];
  over: Over | null;
  accepted: boolean;
  status: DnDStatus;
  mode: DragMode;
}>();

// Up to six in a row, the grabbed item first. Only the grabbed one and four next to it
// have a clone: the sixth shows `DragPreview`'s slot instead.
const MAX = 6;
const shown = computed(() => props.items.slice(0, MAX));
</script>

<template>
  <!-- The root fills the overlay box: the size of the slot, animated on drop. -->
  <div class="strip" :class="{ refused: over && !accepted, landing: status === 'dropping' }">
    <code class="caption">
      items: {{ items.length }} · mode: '{{ mode }}' · over: {{ over ? `'${over.id}'` : 'null' }} · accepted: {{ accepted }}
    </code>
    <!-- A wrapper places each preview: without a clone, `DragPreview` renders only its slot. -->
    <div v-for="(entry, index) in shown" :key="entry.id" class="cell" :style="{ left: `calc(${index} * (100% + 8px))` }">
      <DragPreview :id="entry.id">
        <span class="no-clone">{{ entry.id }}</span>
      </DragPreview>
    </div>
    <span v-if="items.length > MAX" class="more" :style="{ left: `calc(${MAX} * (100% + 8px))` }">+{{ items.length - MAX }}</span>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
